mentions.name: tiny.help
mentions.description: Support desk platform built as an alternative to tools like Intercom. Its key feature is an MCP connection: a ticket with a bug can be pulled down and handed to an agent like Claude or Codex to fix the issue and draft a reply in the operator's own voice. Customers can also connect their own agents to the desk to ask questions, enabling agent-to-agent support with a human in the loop, alongside day-to-day live support and AI-enabled support.
mentions.problem: Frustration with existing support systems after years of using tools like Intercom.
mentions.source_excerpt: I got so fed up with my support system, and after years of using tools like Intercom, I built my own platform with everything I've ever wanted in a support desk.
